 RISING STAR. Jorrybell Agoto stars in the acclaimed film 'Filipiñana.' 
 Filipiñana film still 
 INFO 
 The lead star of the Philippines' official entry to the 2027 Oscars succumbs to her battle with lymphoma 
 MANILA, Philippines – Jorrybell Agoto, the lead actress of Filipiñana , passed away, Epicmedia Productions announced on Thursday, November 19. 
 Epicmedia is among the film production companies responsible for bringing to life the black comedy film. Born in 1994, Agoto portrayed the main character, Isabel, a 17-year-old tee-girl for an exclusive golf club in the Philippines.
 “You have touched our lives. Rest now, Belly,” Epicmedia wrote. 
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Epicmedia Productions (@epicmediaph) 
 In September, the Filipiñana team, along with Agoto’s friends through the Instagram account “Jorrybell Beats It,” had appealed to the public for support after the actress was placed under critical care as she battled lymphoma, a type of blood cancer that affects the immune system.
 Agoto’s death comes just a day after the people behind “Jorrybell Beats It” held an acoustic night on Wednesday, November 18 to help raise funds for her hospitalization and medical expenses.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Jorrybell Beats It (@bellybeatsit) 
 Details of Agoto’s memorial services have yet to be announced. 
 Filipiñana is the Philippines’ official entry to the 2027 Oscars under the Best International Feature Film category. The shortlists will be announced on December 16, while the awards ceremony will be held on March 14, 2027, at the Dolby Theatre in Hollywood, Los Angeles. – Rappler.com
